import java.util.Scanner;

public class e1542easy {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int mod = scanner.nextInt();
        computePermutations(n, mod);
    }

    public static void computePermutations(int n, int mod) {
        int[][] inversions = new int[n][];
        inversions[0] = new int[]{1};

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int[] last = inversions[i - 1];
            int[] next = new int[i * (i + 1) / 2 + 1];

            for (int j = 0; j < next.length; j++) {
                int sum = 0;
                for (int k = Math.min(j, i); k >= 0; k--) {
                    if (j - k < last.length) {
                        sum += last[j - k];
                        sum %= mod;
                    }
                }
                next[j] = sum;
            }
            inversions[i] = next;
        }

        int[] perms = new int[n];
        perms[0] = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int c = (perms[i - 1] * i) % mod;
            int[] inv = inversions[i - 1];

            for (int j = 0; j < inv.length; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 2; k < inv.length; k++) {
                    int delta = inv[j] * inv[k] * (k - j - 1) * (2 * i - (k - j - 2)) / 2;
                    c = (c + delta) % mod;
                }
            }
            perms[i] = c;
        }

        System.out.println(perms[n - 1]);
    }
}
